buttons.addZoom: Add a zoom at the current time
buttons.autoFocusAllTip: All zooms follow the cursor. Off: you choose the focus of each zoom.
buttons.clearTimeline: Remove all zooms, trims, speeds, annotations and Full Camera. Clips, audio and captions stay.
buttons.addTrim: Add a trim: removes a section of the video at the current time
buttons.addAnnotation: Add text, an arrow, an image or a blur at the current time
buttons.addSpeed: Add a speed change at the current time
buttons.addCameraFullscreen: Add Full Camera: shows the camera full screen at the current time

hints.pressAudio: Press {{audioKey}} to add audio, {{voiceoverKey}} to record a voiceover
hints.pressCameraFullscreen: Press {{key}} to add a Full Camera segment

trails.zoomIn: Zoom-in: the view moves in until the zoom starts
trails.zoomOut: Zoom-out: the view moves back out after the zoom ends
trails.zoomInCut: A trim removes {{seconds}} s of the zoom-in. The export jumps at the cut.
trails.zoomOutCut: A trim removes {{seconds}} s of the zoom-out. The export jumps at the cut.
trails.zoomInJunction: A clip junction removes {{seconds}} s of the zoom-in. The export jumps at the junction.
trails.zoomOutJunction: A clip junction removes {{seconds}} s of the zoom-out. The export jumps at the junction.
trails.pan: Pan: the view moves straight to the next zoom

emptyState.dragAndDrop: Drag and drop a video to start editing

errors.zoomExistsAtLocation: Zoom already exists at this location or not enough space available.
errors.noCursorTelemetry: No cursor data in this recording
errors.noCursorTelemetryDescription: Record your screen with OpenScreen to get zooms that follow the cursor.
errors.noUsableTelemetryDescription: The recording does not include enough cursor movement data.
errors.noDwellMoments: No clear cursor dwell moments found
errors.noDwellMomentsDescription: Try a recording with slower cursor pauses on important actions.
errors.noAutoZoomSlotsDescription: The moments found already have zooms on them.
errors.trimExistsAtLocation: Trim already exists at this location or not enough space available.
errors.speedExistsAtLocation: Speed region already exists at this location or not enough space available.
errors.cameraFullscreenExistsAtLocation: A Full Camera segment already exists at this location or not enough space available.

toolbar.arrangeClipsHint: Drag clips below to reorder or drop new ones in
toolbar.dragToReorderHint: Drag to reorder. Double-click to change the start and end.
toolbar.noAutoZoomMomentsDescription: This recording has no recorded clicks, or none with room for a zoom.
toolbar.keycapsHint: Shows the shortcuts recorded with the take, such as ⌘K
toolbar.noKeycapsDescription: Turn on Record keys before recording to capture them.
toolbar.smartCutsLocalHint: Cuts where nothing is said or done, speeds up what you do without talking
toolbar.noTranscriptForCutsDescription: The speech has not been transcribed yet. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
toolbar.addedSmartCuts: Cut {{cut}} s of dead time and sped up {{fast}} s
toolbar.smartCutsLocalFailed: Could not cut the idle time
toolbar.aiEnhanceRequested: Asked the AI agent to cut the dead time
toolbar.smartCutsFailed: Transcription failed — retry it from Media
toolbar.addedWord: Added word: "{{word}}" — no audio behind it

audio.subtitle: Place a voiceover or background music layer on the timeline
audio.importFileHint: Bring in music or an audio file
audio.recordingHint: Narrate along with the video — it plays while you record
audio.importFailed: Could not import the audio file

keycapsDialog.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keycapsDialog.intro: Show the keys you pressed as keys on the video. Each key comes in as if pressed, with a + between them.
keycapsDialog.none: No keys were recorded. Turn on Record keys in the Record screen before recording.
keycapsDialog.onlyKeysHint: For example E Q W Space. Leave empty to follow the choice above.
keycapsDialog.manualHint: At the playhead. Write it like Cmd+Shift+Z or E.
keycapsDialog.manualInvalid: Write a key, for example Cmd+K or E.
